# Java Framework Migration
Evaluate Java framework modernization, including Spring Boot versus Quarkus, using explicit technical criteria and evidence for an Azure AKS target.
Assess current framework, Java, architecture, dependencies, startup time, memory, reflection/proxy requirements, security, persistence, messaging, observability, testing, build, image and AKS resource model.
Compare functional compatibility, migration effort, operations, startup/memory characteristics, developer productivity, ecosystem, testing, security, observability, AKS suitability and maintenance.
For a PoC, use a representative minimal application and measure startup, memory, image size, throughput and test behavior where practical.
Create an ADR with context, current state, options, criteria, evidence, decision, consequences, assumptions and follow-up actions.
Do not perform a framework rewrite during assessment unless explicitly requested.
